output_accounting.finding: The upstream adapter returns one output sample per input sample with identity source-time mapping and zero delay compensation. This model emits exactly len(input) samples; internal padding exists only for gain estimation.

source_reported_context.candidate_row: Denoising,ClearVoice MossFormerGAN,evaluated,30/30 frozen DNS paired quality outputs verified across three exact-candidate batches; mean SNR 20.70 dB, SI-SDR 20.69 dB, STOI .9825; delta SI-SDR +2.51 dB vs FastEnhancer Small and +0.57 dB vs FRCRN; only four per-item times (RTF 10.50-11.76); earlier CPU batches timed out.
source_reported_context.census_row: Attention/GAN; 16 kHz single-channel quality candidate. Five-clip screening only: mean delta SNR +7.91 dB and mean delta STOI +0.0461, all five improved on both. No inferential interval or full 30-clip comparison is claimed. CPU throughput is several times slower than real time; clean-input check is pending.
